g.text: RICK & MORTY PORTAL GUN — FRITZING BREADBOARD WIRING SCHEMATIC
Full 830-Point Solderless Breadboard Assembly | Arduino Nano ESP32 | Complete System
• Mini360 Buck Converter (+5V Out) connects to Breadboard Red (+5V) Rail; OUT- connects to Blue (GND) Rail.
• Switched 7.4V battery line (P-05 dashed red) connects directly to Nano ESP32 VIN (Col 21, Row F).
• 1000 µF 10V capacitor plugs directly between Top Red (+) and Top Blue (-) power rails at Column 4.
⚠️ NEVER connect Joystick VCC to 5V! Connect strictly to Nano 3.3V Pin (Col 7, Row F).
• VRX ➔ A0 (Col 9), VRY ➔ A1 (Col 10), SW ➔ D9 (Col 9). Single GND to Blue GND Rail.
• Sleep/Wake Button Pin 1 ➔ D10 (Col 8, RTC_GPIO21); Pin 2 ➔ Blue GND Rail.
• BCLK ➔ D11 (Col 7), LRC ➔ D12 (Col 6), DIN ➔ D13 (Col 6). VIN ➔ Red Rail, GND & GAIN ➔ Blue Rail.
⚠️ Speaker SPK- is Bridge-Tied Load (BTL): NEVER ground speaker wires!
• TM1637: CLK ➔ D7 (Col 11), DIO ➔ D8 (Col 10). NeoPixels: Ring ➔ D5 (Col 13), Strip ➔ D6 (Col 12).
• 3x Green LEDs mount directly on Breadboard with 220Ω resistors from D2 (Col 16), D3 (Col 15), D4 (Col 14).
